title: All cipher suites enabled in nginx — review required
description: ssl_ciphers ALL offers every suite the TLS library implements, including export, NULL and anonymous suites where they exist. The client then picks from a set that was never reviewed. The rule flags the directive; the linked library version determines which suites actually survive.
remediation: Restrict ssl_ciphers to a reviewed modern list and disable anonymous and NULL suites.
limitation: Lexical: matches the literal ALL token; a named list is out of scope even when it is weak.
